content: Mandate bcrypt for password hashing with salt rounds >= 10, and sign stateless session tokens using jsonwebtoken (JWT) with expiration.
Use Express standard HTTP status codes (200, 201, 400, 401, 404, 500) and implement centralized error-handling middleware with structured JSON responses.
Define compound indexes for frequently queried fields in Mongoose, enable query lean() for read operations, and avoid deeply nested subdocuments.
Implement Redis or in-memory LRU TTL caching for high-frequency read endpoints and expensive AI response generation to reduce database latency.
Ensure mobile-first responsive styling using CSS flexbox/grid, modular components, and centralized state or React context for user sessions.
Dockerize microservices with multi-stage Dockerfiles, enforce environment variable isolation via .env, and include healthcheck endpoints.
